WITH hand_totals AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN p.bats IS NULL OR TRIM(p.bats) = '' THEN '(blank/missing)'
            ELSE p.bats
        END AS hand,
        COUNT(*) AS tally
    FROM player_award AS a
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
    GROUP BY 1
), shares AS (
    SELECT hand, tally,
           1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_totals
), scored AS (
    SELECT hand, tally, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT hand, tally, share, share - average_share AS excess_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY hand;

assumptions.assumption: Each row in player_award counts as one award; awards are matched to known players by player_id, and NULL or whitespace-only batting hand is grouped as '(blank/missing)'. The simple average is the unweighted mean of the shares across distinct hand groups, including the blank/missing group when present.
